procedure.method: In this fresh independent session I read the exact pinned packet, case, rubric, rules and compact instructions; verified the pinned bytes; and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet supplies no source assets or protected-layout manifests, so both source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. I then actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact poster assets using tools.view_image with detail original, sequentially in five functions.exec calls: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. Every call returned the exact image for visual inspection. Only after M5 thumbnail320 had been displayed did I begin the first copy-reading/transcription stage, then judgments and scores. First readings were taken from the already displayed native pixels with the completed usage/thumbnail views available to assess layout and readability. All 55 first readings are retained; no ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed and no further poster opens were made. All views are available and correctly bound; usage views are 720×405 and thumbnails 320×180. The native ratios pass the declared 0.5-pixel single-edge rounding policy, not mathematical equality. I did not generate/edit images, inspect peer reviews, spawn/resume/fork, or claim a tool event or runtime session identity from filenames or helper success.

residuals: The five systems show meaningful whole-composition differences, sufficient for diversity 4 rather than palette/material-only substitutions. They are not maximally divergent: M1, M2 and M4 share empty architecture with text distributed on room surfaces, while M3 and M5 share exhibition-plus-conversation imagery.

Shared practical sans type and warm daylight give the set a common family resemblance; distinction depends on the changed viewpoint, crop, occupied space and identity/information roles described for every member.

Preserved low dimensions are M2 content_form/emotion_control, M3 hierarchy and M5 typography. The full-set all-dimensions floor therefore is not met in this editorial review despite exact count and diversity 4.
